bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/core_location.rs (SDK module); springboard/src/shell/services/location.rs (shell service). Other pieces: springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs (Location struct :116, GEOCODE_API :25, parse_places :253); springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs (format_gps :110, read_gps :324)
summary: Apple's framework gives apps device position, heading, geofences, beacons and geocoding behind a permission prompt. BifrOSt has an SDK location module (LocationManager, reverse and forward geocoding) that the shell answers from a fixed location set in Settings, with a location permission sheet; there is no device position source, no location manifest permission, and no geofence or heading feed for apps.

features.apple: CLLocationManager, CLLocationUpdate, CLBackgroundActivitySession, CLServiceSession (Getting the current location of a device; Handling location updates in the background)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/core_location.rs (LocationManager, Delegate, Location, accuracy levels, distance filter); springboard/src/shell/services/location.rs (shell location service: fixed location from Settings prefs; approximate 3 km grid unless the app has Precise Location, location.precise.<app>; global switch location.services.enabled; last use in memory only)
features.note: Tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-16.rs (authorization replies, update and failure delivery, distance filter, decoding, error codes, usage texts); not yet checked on Midget. Authorization state machine runs through the privacy grants (notDetermined to authorizedWhenInUse or denied); requestLocation, start/stopUpdatingLocation, didUpdateLocations and didFailWithError are delivered to a delegate. No GPS hardware and no Wi-Fi positioning: a fix is the fixed location the person sets (100 m). The IP-address estimate was removed: no third-party lookup is called and no cloud geo endpoint exists (bifrost-cloud has none). Approximate apps get a 3 km grid. Shell tests for the rounding, switch, precision and last use are in springboard/src/shell/services/location.rs and springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs (not run: lead runs them). No altitude, no background updates, no CLLocationUpdate/CLServiceSession.

features.note: Authorization status, accuracy, usage texts and error codes are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-17.rs. The shell privacy service, the SDK privacy client and the weather app use this model for the Settings switch and the request sheet; not yet verified on Midget. Gap: the manifest permission list (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs) has no location entry, so apps cannot declare a location use. The purpose string comes from the manifest table `[privacy] location = "..."` (springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs Manifest.location_purpose) and a location_request without it is refused (springboard/src/shell/services/privacy_permissions.rs location_purpose_gate); the request sheet does not show the text yet. The menu bar indicator state is modelled (springboard/src/shell/services/location.rs Location::in_use) but not drawn. Gaps: no Settings > Privacy > Location page (per-app list, Precise switch, last use), no Allow Once choice (the sheet has two buttons), and the manifest permission list (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs) has no location entry. Host tests written, not run.

A saved place is a public struct in the shell's Weather data module with a name, region, latitude and longitude, and a two-decimal cache key; the values, the saved list and the key are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: no accuracy, timestamp, altitude, course, speed, floor or visit data, and no SDK type.

features.note: The BifrOSt beacon in net/share.rs (BEACON_PORT 5354, springboard/src/net/share.rs:34) announces a sharing peer on the local network. It is not BLE iBeacon. iBeacon needs Bluetooth LE advertising and ranging, which no SDK API exposes. Marked n/a only because the framework is Apple-specific and deprecated; the proximity use case is a gap.

gaps: No device position source: the shell service reports the fixed location set in Settings; there is no GPS, Wi-Fi positioning or geoclue client in springboard/src or netd.
The app manifest permission list (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs) has no location entry, so an app cannot declare a location permission; the purpose string comes from [privacy] location.
Reverse geocoding is host-tested only, within 50 km of the known places (springboard/ui/src/reverse_lookup.rs); there is no worldwide gazetteer, and forward geocoding finds only the known places.
Region monitoring is a host-tested model (springboard/ui/src/geofence.rs) fed by the caller, with no position source; notifications have no location triggers (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Notifications gaps).
The magnetometer heading model is in the SDK (sensors::magnetometer), but no magnetometer reader feeds it; the shell reads the accelerometer only (springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs). No course data.
No background location session and no asynchronous CLLocationUpdate stream; live updates reach apps through the LocationManager delegate only.
